命中 30 次爆头，可获得 +20% 暴击几率与 +50% 暴击伤害，持续 45 秒。

命中 65 次躯干，可获得 +90% 武器伤害，持续 45 秒。

Hitting 30 headshots grant +20% critical hit chance and +50% critical hit damage for 45s.

Hitting 65 bodyshots grant +90% weapon damage for 45s.

Hitting 20 legshots grant +150% reload speed for 45s.

talent.name: 王牌猎人
talent.desc_zh:
使用瞄准镜时，切换至半自动射击模式，每次攻击造成的武器伤害变为 450%。

击中头部带来 +6% 爆头伤害。可叠加 25 次。叠加已满时，每 4 秒会衰减 10 层叠加，直到所有叠加效果都消失为止。击中头部能延迟叠加效果衰减。

When scoped, switches to semi-automatic fire mode, dealing 450% weapon damage with each shot.

Headshots grant +6% headshot damage. Stacks up to 25 times. Once at full stacks, 10 stacks decay every 4 seconds until all stacks have been removed. Headshots delay decaying of stacks.

就绪后，切换至此武器便可获得射击时 +25% 射速、+30% 武器伤害且产生的威胁提升 100%，持续 20 秒。

talent.name: 黑道暗杀
talent.desc_zh:
用该武器射击敌人时，会施加一个标记。你在同一时间只能施加一个标记。射击其他敌人时，标记会转移。

其他特工可以用此武器对同一敌人施加更多标记。一名敌人身上的最大标记数为 4 个。

此武器能对被标记的敌人造成 +20% 额外伤害。敌人身上每有一个额外标记，此加成均会提升 5%。
talent.desc_en:
Shooting an enemy with this weapon applies a mark. You can only apply one mark at a time. Shooting another enemy will transfer the mark.

More marks can be applied on the same enemy by other agents using this weapon. Maximum amount of marks that can be applied on an enemy is 4.

This weapon deals +20% Amplified Damage to marked enemies. The bonus is increased by 5% for each extra mark on the enemy other than your own.

为护盾提供此武器造成伤害 25% 的修复。
talent.desc_en:
While having a Shield deployed, lose Shield Health at a rate of 10% per second.
Your Shield receives repairs of 25% of the damage dealt by this weapon.

talent.name: 完美反复
talent.desc_zh:
切换至此武器后获得 +13% 射速和 +12% 武器伤害，持续 10 秒。

切走此武器后获得 +5% 射速和 +4.5% 武器伤害，持续 10 秒。

如果在原加成仍生效时获得了新的加成，则会将其覆盖。

该天赋的两个效果无法同时生效。
talent.desc_en:
Swapping to this weapon grants +13% Rate of Fire and +12% Weapon Damage for 10s.

Swapping from this weapon grants +5% Rate of Fire and +4.5% Weapon Damage for 10s.

Receiving one of the bonus groups will remove the other if it's still active.

Two instances of this Talent will not function at the same time.

4 - 混乱

Shooting a target applies stacks of venom, which last for 10s. Increasing stacks adds more severe debuffs to the target.

4 - Disorient
6 - Shock

Duration of Status Effects is based on percentage of pellets hit on applying shot.

“维持权力需要有人冷酷无情。绝对地冷酷无情。”
——“暴乱”，鬣狗议会成员

- Mayhem, Hyena Councilmember

talent.name: 双向扳机
talent.desc_zh:
此武器在扣下与放开扳机时都会发射子弹。

若两发子弹击中相同目标即可获得一次叠加效果。

累积至 7 次时，射击敌人将会增加 +500% 伤害并引起范围 7 米的爆炸，造成 500% 的武器伤害，并消耗叠加效果。
talent.desc_en:
This weapon fires on trigger pull and release. 

If both bullets hit the same enemy, gain a stack.

At 7 stacks, shooting an enemy deals +500% amplified damage and creates a 7m explosion dealing 500% weapon damage, consuming the stacks.

talent.name: 刷新中
talent.desc_zh:
该武器能够射出水流。命中己方特工后会为其叠加效果。最多 5 层。叠加的层数每过 2 秒损耗一层。
当至少有 1 层时，己方会获得 +50% 危害防护。
talent.desc_en:
The weapon fires a stream of water. Hitting an ally agent builds stacks on them. Max stack is 5. Stacks deplete every 2s.
While having at least 1 stack, the ally will have +50% Hazard Protection.

talent.name: 游走射击
talent.desc_zh:
移动时，你每秒积累 5 层增益效果，最大 100  层。用利希腾贝格爆头时能获得 15 层和 20% 移动速度，持续 5 秒。

在层数达到最大后，下一次用利希腾贝格命中会消耗全部层数，造成 200% 额外伤害，并电击目标，持续 2 秒。
talent.desc_en:
While moving, you accrue 5 stacks per second, up to a maximum of 100 stacks. Headshots with Lichtenberg grant 15 stacks and 20% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

While at maximum stacks your next shot with Lichtenberg consumes all stacks, deals 200% bonus damage and Shocks the target for 2 seconds.

talent.name: 完美同步伤害

击中一名敌人会获得 +20% 技能伤害，持续 5 秒。

talent.name: 痛苦龇咬
talent.desc_zh:
响尾蛇会随机标记一名 20 米内的敌人。若 20 米内没有敌人，则标记离你最近的敌人。

击中该敌人会消耗标记并造成一次具有 20% 伤害加成的暴击攻击。

击中标记目标后，所有攻击都会暴击，持续 5 秒。

在你装弹时以及装弹完毕后，会再随机标记一名新敌人。
talent.desc_en:
Diamondback randomly marks an enemy within 20m. If no enemies are within 20m, it marks the enemy closest to you.

Hitting that enemy consumes the mark, guaranteeing a critical hit with damage amplified by 20%. 

After hitting a mark, all shots fired are guaranteed critical hits for 5s.

A new random enemy is marked afterwards and whenever you reload.

Body shots add 1 stack to the enemy for 10s. Max stacks: 4. 
Hitting a different enemy removes all stacks.

This weapon deals +4% Amplified Damage per stack.

Your next headshot on an enemy with stacks consumes all stacks, dealing +11% Amplified Damage per stack.

Destroying an enemy's weakpoint causes them to take +30% Amplified Damage from you for 5s.

talent.name: 基利和库力奇
talent.desc_zh:
扣下扳机会同时从两个枪管进行射击。

当枪架在右肩时，命中目标可获得攻击基底。当枪架在左肩时，命中目标可获得防御基底。

从其中一肩射击命中时将会引爆现存所有另一肩的基底效果。

引爆时，每一点攻击基底造成 +100% 武器伤害，而每一点防御基底可获得 +4% 加成装甲，并增加 +10% 对装甲板伤害，持续 5 秒。

talent.desc_en:
On trigger-pull, fire both barrels at once.

When fired from the right  shoulder, hits add offensive primers, and defensive primers when fired from the left shoulder.

Hits from one shoulder will detonate all of the opposite shoulder's primers when present.

When detonated, each offensive primer deals 100% weapon damage, while each defensive primer grants +4% bonus armor and +10% amplified damage to armor plates  for 5s.

Primer effectiveness is doubled at 10 stacks.

talent.name: 掩体枪手
talent.desc_zh:
如果位于掩体中，则每次射击都会提升 1% 武器伤害，最多 100%。加成能够持续 15 秒。

用此武器在掩体中达成击杀时，可以重置持续时间。

装弹、切换武器或离开战斗时，伤害加成失效。
talent.desc_en:
Every bullet fired while in cover increases Weapon Damage by 1% up to 100%. The bonus lasts for 15s.

Getting a kill with this weapon while in cover resets the duration.

The bonus damage is cancelled by reloading, swapping weapons or exiting combat.

talent.name: 干扰子弹
talent.desc_zh:
击中敌人时对其进行标记，并为特工增加一层效果，最多叠加50层。击中带有标记的敌人时，刷新其身上的标记，并为特工增加一层效果。
当你 使用一项非护盾类技能时，移除特工身上的所有层数，同时所有被标记的敌人按层数触发效果。

1 - 10 层 - 对被标记的目标造成脉冲效果，持续 5 秒
11 - 25 层 - 对被标记的目标造成脉冲和干扰效果，持续 5 秒。
26 - 49 层 - 对被标记的目标造成脉冲，干扰和混乱效果，持续 5 秒。
50 层 - 对被标记的目标及其周围 10 米内的敌人造成脉冲，干扰和混乱效果，持续 5 秒。此效果会在任意被标记的敌人被消灭后立即触发。
talent.desc_en:
Shooting an enemy marks that enemy and adds a stack to the agent up to a count of 50. Shooting a marked enemy refreshes the mark and adds stacks to the agent.
When you deploy a non-shield skill, remove all stacks on agent and all marked targets trigger an effect.

1 - 10 Stacks - Pulse marked targets for 5 seconds
11 - 25 Stacks - Pulse and Disrupt marked targets for 5 seconds.
26 - 49 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets for 5 seconds.
50 Stacks - Pulse, Disrupt, and Disorient marked targets and all hostiles within 10 meters of the marked targets for 5 seconds. This effect will trigger immediately if any marked enemy is killed.

talent.name: 蚊子之歌
talent.desc_zh:
命中敌人后会叠加一层。玩家间共享层数。

叠加到 5 层时，敌人会强制瞄准最后施加层数的玩家，持续 5 秒，并受到额外 25% 的护甲伤害。

层数每过 5 秒会消减。此效果对一个敌人激活时，会移除其他敌人身上所有的层数。
talent.desc_en:
Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players.

At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor.

Stacks deplete every 5s. Activating the effect on an enemy will remove all stacks from other enemies.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_mosquito
mods.desc_zh: 讽刺的是，朝你头飞来的时候，你是听不见这些的。
mods.desc_en: Ironically, you won’t hear these fly at your head.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_mpx_01
mods.desc_zh: “钉刺！”
mods.desc_en: Spikes!

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_p90_01
mods.desc_zh: 让闲聊变成安静的呢喃。
mods.desc_en: Quiets the chatter to a gentle murmur.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_pdr_01
mods.desc_zh: 通过枪口电能强化射出的子弹。
mods.desc_en: The electrical build-up transfers to the fired round via the muzzle

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_ravenous
mods.desc_zh: 拥有双枪管，想要吃东西。
mods.desc_en: Double barreled and looking to feed.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_regulus
mods.desc_zh: 老鼠的啮咬锋利无比又充满病菌，小心不要被咬到。
mods.desc_en: A rat's bite is viciously sharp and laden with disease. Be careful not to get bit.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_sacrum
mods.desc_zh: 他们都会呼求救赎。
mods.desc_en: They'll all call out for salvation.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_senate
mods.desc_zh: 威力无穷。
mods.desc_en: Unlimited power.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_six12_01
mods.desc_zh: 得尽可能避开的针刺。
mods.desc_en: A stinger to be avoided at all costs.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_srs_01
mods.desc_zh: 消除枪口焰并降低枪击声响，适合隐密进攻。
mods.desc_en: Eliminates muzzle flash and reduces sound report of shots for covert engagements.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_svd_01
mods.desc_zh: 为目标能够听到的最后一声响增加些许余韵。
mods.desc_en: Provides the final touch for the last sound the target ever hears.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_vector_01
mods.desc_zh: 降低枪口噪音以进行潜行攻击。
mods.desc_en: Dampens muzzle noise to allow for stealth assaults.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_vector_t3_v1_exotic
mods.desc_zh: 能抵御任何环境因素的影响。
mods.desc_en: Can withstand any of the elements.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_vindicator
mods.desc_zh: 与眼罩系统连接，一定能保证命中。
mods.desc_en: Connected to the Scope’s System to provide guaranteed success.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_muzzle_winchester_01
mods.desc_zh: 绝对不是响尾蛇。
mods.desc_en: Definitely not a Diamondback.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_acr_t1_v1_exotic
mods.desc_zh: “三思而后行”
mods.desc_en: “Measure twice, cut once”

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_assaultrifle_01
mods.desc_zh: 没有分散注意力之物，也没有光学仪器，只有猎手与猎物。
mods.desc_en: No distractions, no optics. Just a predator and her prey.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_assaultrifle_03
mods.desc_zh: 瞄准镜可对远距离目标发动单一精准射击。
mods.desc_en: The scope enables single precise shots on distant targets.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_assaultrifle_pdr_01
mods.desc_zh: 能将目标周遭的空气离子化，增加导电力的光学瞄准镜。
mods.desc_en: Optical scope which ionizes the air around the target increasing electrical conductivity

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_assaultrifle_six12_01
mods.desc_zh: 在黑暗中发光的瞄准具，适用于低光环境。
mods.desc_en: Glow in the dark sight finders perfect for low light situations

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_bee
mods.desc_zh: 可能会让人分不清红色。
mods.desc_en: May make seeing the color red tricky.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_deserteagle_01
mods.desc_zh: “自由”的瞄准具经过改造，可标示出弱点。
mods.desc_en: Liberty's sight has been modified to highlight vulnerabilities.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_home
mods.desc_zh: 使用时无需手术灯。
mods.desc_en: You won't require surgical lights while using this.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_ironlung
mods.desc_zh: 来自远古传说的凝视。
mods.desc_en: Perfecting the line over hundreds of years.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_kac_01
mods.desc_zh: 设计周全的人体工学瞄准具，能够帮助你快速换弹。
mods.desc_en: An ergonomic, balanced sight which aids in quick operation of loading mechanisms.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_ladydeath
mods.desc_zh: 通过你，我看见了终结。
mods.desc_en: Through you, I see the end.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_mpx_01
mods.desc_zh: “需要更多钉刺。”
mods.desc_en: Needs more spikes.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_ohcarol
mods.desc_zh: 适用于长型顶部导轨的放大瞄准镜。
mods.desc_en: Magnifying scope for long top rails

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_overlord
mods.desc_zh: 能解决所有临时弹药问题。
mods.desc_en: For all your makeshift projectile problems.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_p90_01
mods.desc_zh: 通过这种光学仪器看出去，好像在看万花筒。
mods.desc_en: Peering through these optics looks like a kaleidoscope.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_ravenous
mods.desc_zh: 对于掠夺者来说，追捕猎物永远没有结束的一天。
mods.desc_en: For a predator, the hunt for prey never ends.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_sacrum
mods.desc_zh: 但这终究有其局限。
mods.desc_en: But it has its limits.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_senate
mods.desc_zh: 带来震撼的视觉享受。
mods.desc_en: Provides an electrifying view.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_spas12_01
mods.desc_zh: 似乎在大量近身作战下遭到损坏。
mods.desc_en: Appears to be damaged from numerous CQC encounters.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_spas12_02
mods.desc_zh: 对这种武器的持有者来说，能仔细瞄准似乎不是他们追求的功能。
mods.desc_en: Careful aim does not appear to be a function embraced by the owner of this weapon.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_srs_01
mods.desc_zh: 防眩镀膜透镜能减少反光，避免暴露你的所在位置。
mods.desc_en: Anti-Glint lens coating reduces light reflection to avoid giving away your position.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_svd_01
mods.desc_zh: 直刺邪恶之心的目光。
mods.desc_en: This sight seeks the heart of evil.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_vector_01
mods.desc_zh: 追踪弹道并辨识最佳射击位置。
mods.desc_en: Tracks bullet trajectories and identifies optimal shot placement.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_vector_t3_v1_exotic
mods.desc_zh: 优秀到几乎能看到自己的后方。
mods.desc_en: So good you can nearly see behind yourself.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_vindicator
mods.desc_zh: 用进化的眼光看问题。
mods.desc_en: See through the eyes of evolution.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_optic_winchester_01
mods.desc_zh: 特殊的系统单芯片设计，可以迅速发现目标。
mods.desc_en: Unique system-on-a-chip design allows for rapid target acquisition.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_scope_awm
mods.desc_zh: 多强度的瞄准镜，附有集成的遥测功能，可迅速快放电容回馈。
mods.desc_en: Variable power scope with integrated telemetry for fast-discharge capacitor feedback.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_acr_t1_v1_exotic
mods.desc_zh: “从一个人的抓握方式，就可以看出其为人”
mods.desc_en: “You can judge a man by his grip”

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_akm_01
mods.desc_zh: 在伪装下的一张便条写着：“祝你握着好运。”
mods.desc_en: A note under the camouflage says, "Good luck holding on.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_akm_02
mods.desc_zh: 沿着握把写着：“你会需要我的”。
mods.desc_en: Writing along the grip: "You'll need me.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_assaultrifle_01
mods.desc_zh: 如果使用太久，很有可能会导致腕隧道症候群。
mods.desc_en: Likely to induce carpal tunnel if used for protracted engagements.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_awm_01
mods.desc_zh: 稳定武器平台，可提高准确度并减少操作者的疲劳。
mods.desc_en: Stabilizes the weapon platform for increased accuracy and reduced operator fatigue.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_bee
mods.desc_zh: 在磁场中能够发挥作用。
mods.desc_en: Functioning with magnetic efficiency.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_bighorn
mods.desc_zh: 带有沟槽的角状握把后脊有助于控制后座力。
mods.desc_en: Grooved horn grip ridges aid recoil control.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_bullethell
mods.desc_zh: 纯粹装饰用的武器附件，但能通过增加重量来抵抗后座力，提升稳定度。
mods.desc_en: Purely ornamental weapon attachment, grants some stability with added weight against recoil.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_deserteagle_01
mods.desc_zh: “自由”的扳机经过精心调校，以确保其可靠性。
mods.desc_en: Liberty's trigger is carefully crafted to ensure reliability.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_home
mods.desc_zh: 只适合有如手术刀般精准的人。
mods.desc_en: Only for those with surgical precision.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_ironlung
mods.desc_zh: 这玩意握持起来还挺舒服。
mods.desc_en: Scales are surprisingly grippy.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_kac_01
mods.desc_zh: 经过改造的握把，就算手很抖也能尽量保持稳定。
mods.desc_en: Modified grip for maximizing stability even with shaking hands.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_ladydeath
mods.desc_zh: 通过你，我传达了自己的怒气。
mods.desc_en: Through you, I deliver my anger.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_m249_01
mods.desc_zh: 流亡者最棒的枪支外包装。
mods.desc_en: Nothing but the finest in Outcast outer-wear for this gun.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_mpx_01
mods.desc_zh: “一旦握上就爱不释手！”
mods.desc_en: Easy to grip, hard to let go!

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_overlord
mods.desc_zh: 就像手套一样。
mods.desc_en: Like a glove.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_p90_01
mods.desc_zh: 黏在罐上的一张便条写着：“他妈的别打开它”。
mods.desc_en: A note taped to the canister says, "Don't fucking open it.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_pdr_01
mods.desc_zh: 在武器发射时少数能安全握持武器的位置。
mods.desc_en: One of the few safe locations to hold the weapon whilst charged

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_ravenous
mods.desc_zh: 小心这个爪子，但记住——被狼咬才会死人。
mods.desc_en: Beware the claw, but remember - it's the bite that kills.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_sacrum
mods.desc_zh: 迎接铁锤吧。
mods.desc_en: Meet the hammer.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_senate
mods.desc_zh: 未佩戴手套时禁止操作。
mods.desc_en: Don’t operate without gloves.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_six12_01
mods.desc_zh: 此握把会掐住用户达到防滑效果。
mods.desc_en: This grip actively pinches the wielder ensuring no slippage.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_spas12_01
mods.desc_zh: 看来足以把人打晕。
mods.desc_en: Looks like it's capable of inducing a coma.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_spas12_02
mods.desc_zh: 鬣狗组装起来的某种玩意儿。
mods.desc_en: Some kind of contraption rigged by the Hyenas.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_srs_01
mods.desc_zh: 这个定制框架让你在装备吉利网的同时也不会影响武器功能。
mods.desc_en: A custom frame for mounting ghillie netting without compromising weapon function.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_svd_01
mods.desc_zh: 能够抑制发抖的特制枪身。
mods.desc_en: A special frame which reduces shake.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_vector_01
mods.desc_zh: 耐热防滑握把可在任何条件下进行精确控制。
mods.desc_en: Heat resistant non-slip grip allows precise control under any conditions.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_vector_t3_v1_exotic
mods.desc_zh: 就其尺寸而言，非常结实。
mods.desc_en: Very sturdy for its size.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_vindicator
mods.desc_zh: 与科技合二为一。
mods.desc_en: Be one with your tech.

mods.name: w_mod_exo_underbarrel_winchester_01
mods.desc_zh: 一种可调节的握把，可提升利用杠杆上膛子弹时的武器掌握度。
mods.desc_en: An adjustable grip that allows for control while reloading via the lever.

talents.en: From the Shadows Into the Light
talents.desc_zh:
在掩体后时，每秒获得 10 层叠加效果，最多可叠加至 50 层。每叠加一层，爆击伤害都将提高 1.2%，同时每分钟射速提高 0.4%。

从掩体后射击时，该增益不会生效。

走出掩体后，玩家以正常速度移动时每秒失去 2 层叠加效果，冲刺时每秒失去 1 层叠加效果。

在掩体外处于战斗状态时，每秒获得 10 层叠加效果，最多可叠加至 50 层。每一层效果被消耗时，都将回复玩家 0.8% 的装甲。
只有在掩体后时，该叠加效果才会以每秒 10 层的速度消耗。
talents.desc_en:
While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 1.2% Critical damage increase and 0.4%  RPM.

Buff does not apply while shooting from cover.

While out of cover Agents lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.

While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed.

Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover.

talents.desc_zh:
命中被状态效果影响的敌人后会将其标记。

击杀标记的敌人会为自身使用中的武器填满空尖弹，并为其他队员使用中的武器装填一半相同子弹。

标记持续10秒。

空尖弹会提升 40% 武器伤害，并在命中时施加出血效果。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark.

Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of Hollow-Point Ammo for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party

Mark lasts for 10 seconds.

Hollow-Point Ammo amplifies weapon damage by 40% and applies bleed on hit.

talents.zh: 奥提兹迅捷应用纳米原型
talents.desc_zh:
治疗技能的持续时间和范围减少 90%，但其治疗效率提升 150%。

用技能治疗盟友时，会为其提供 30% 危害防护，持续 10 秒。
每名盟友的冷却时间：10 秒。
talents.desc_en:
Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%.

Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s.
Cooldown per ally: 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
每隔 2 秒，被你击中的敌人会承受叠加的减益效果，有红色、白色与蓝色三种。

红色：该敌人受到的伤害增加 15%。

白色：射击该敌人每秒会修复攻击的特工 2% 装甲。

蓝色：使该敌人造成的伤害降低 10%。

旗帜飘扬：带着 3 种减益效果死亡的敌人会引发范围 5 米的爆炸，造成与其总生命值和装甲相同的伤害。（具名敌人死亡时爆炸伤害会减弱。）
talents.desc_en:
Every 2s, enemies you shoot receive a stacking debuff of Red, White and Blue.
 
Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%.
 
White: Shooting the enemy repairs the attacking agent’s armor by 2% once every second.
 
Blue: Decreases the enemy's damage dealt by 10%.
 
Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all 3 debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. (Explosion damage reduced on Named enemy deaths.)

talents.desc_zh:
每次施加状态效果都有 40% 概率也同时对敌人施加燃烧效果。

如果最初施加的状态效果本身就是燃烧，则敌人会在燃烧持续时间内，受到 +25% 燃烧伤害。
talents.desc_en:
Every Status Effect you apply has a 40% chance of also applying Burn to the enemy.

If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive +25% Burn Damage for the duration of the Burn.

talents.desc_zh:
每次使用或取消一项技能时，另一个技能的冷却时间将自动减少 30 秒，并增加 10% 的技能伤害和修复效果，持续 20 秒。

回馈回路每 10 秒可触发一次。
talents.desc_en:
Whenever you use or cancel a skill, your other skill’s cooldown is automatically reduced by 30s while increasing total skill damage and repair by 10% for 20s.

Feedback Loop can occur once every 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
暴击时会标记敌人 20 秒，最多标记 3 名敌人。

当你暴击一个受标记敌人时，其他被标记敌人全都会承受所造成暴击的 60% 伤害。

只要受标记敌人死亡，就会获得 +10% 的暴击伤害，最多叠加 10 次，或直到战斗结束。
talents.desc_en:
Critical hits mark enemies for 20s, up to 3 marks total.

When you critically hit a marked enemy, all other marked enemies take 60% of the damage dealt.

Whenever a marked enemy dies, gain +10% critical hit damage, stacking up to 10 times, or until combat ends.

talents.desc_zh:
使用特有武器击杀后会增加 15% 的特有武器伤害，持续 10 秒，并且此武器的下一次换弹时 +25% 换弹速度（加成效果不叠加）。

每 60 秒自动补充特有武器弹药。
talents.desc_en:
Getting a Signature Weapon kill gives +15% Signature Weapon Damage for 10s and +25% Reload Speed for the next reload of the weapon (the bonuses do not stack).

Automatically regenerate Signature Weapon Ammo every 60s.

talents.desc_zh:
以步枪或精确射手步枪命中时可翻一次牌。

翻出 5 张牌后，下次命中时伤害将会增加 75%。翻出的手牌愈好，获得加成效果的子弹就愈多。

铁支：4 发子弹。

葫芦：3 发子弹。

死人之手（对A + 对8）：2 发子弹。

爆头时额外翻开一张卡牌。
talents.desc_en:
Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman Rifle. 

After 5 cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by 75%. More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed.

Four of a Kind: 4 shots.

Full House: 3 shots.

Aces and Eights: 2 shots.

Flip an additional card on headshots.

talents.desc_zh:
以一个可以瞬间使用且无限次数的技能替换装甲包，技能效果为修复 20% 装甲，赋予 50% 加成装甲并隐藏你的名条 5 秒，而此技能冷却时间为 20 秒。

每获得 5% 加成装甲，总武器伤害即增加 2%，最多可达 20%。
talents.desc_en:
Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability on a 20s cooldown, that repairs 20% armor, grants 50% bonus armor and hides your nameplate for 5s.

Increases total weapon damage by 2% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%.

talents.desc_zh: 无论你或护盾受到伤害时，伤害量的 25% 可于 10 秒内回复。
talents.desc_en: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 25% of that amount is repaired to both over 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
装甲全满的你和友军可增加 15% 的总武器伤害和技能伤害。

当你为一位友军修复装甲时，你和 5 米范围内的友军也会同时获得 60% 的修复效果。
talents.desc_en:
Increases you and your allies' total weapon and skill damage by 15% when at full armor.  

When you repair an ally, you and all allies within 5m of you are also repaired for 60% of that amount.

talents.desc_zh:
每次使用武器命中目标便会增加 0.65% 总 武器伤害 ，最多可叠加 100 次。

若层数为0 到 50，则每秒会失去 1 层叠加效果。
若层数为50 到 100，则每秒会失去 2 层叠加效果。
talents.desc_en:
Weapon hits increase total weapon damage by 0.65%, stacking up to 100 times.

1 stacks lost per second between 0 and 50 stacks
2 stacks lost per second between 50 and 100 stacks

talents.desc_zh: 你的状态效果会在造成击杀时扩散至 10 米内的所有敌人身上，并重置 50% 的持续时间。
talents.desc_en: Your status effects now spread on kill to all enemies within 10m and refresh 50% of the duration.

talents.desc_zh:
对 15 米内的敌人造成减益效果，提升 20% 你对他们造成的武器伤害。

使用你的武器击杀受受减益效果影响的敌人，可让 5 米内的其他敌人陷入混乱，并提升自身武器伤害 5%，持续 10 秒，最多叠加 5 次。
talents.desc_en:
Enemies within 15m receive a debuff, amplifying your weapon damage against them by 20%.

Killing a debuffed enemy with your weapon disorients other enemies within 5m, and amplifies weapon damage by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.desc_zh:
与自已部署的技能对象互动可使之获得 25% 的技能伤害，持续 10 秒。此增益无法刷新。

互动内容包含：
- 使用或部署技能
- 更改技能的目标
- 修复技能对象
talents.desc_en:
Interacting with your deployed skills grants the skill 25% skill damage for 10s. This buff cannot be refreshed.

Interactions include:
- Using / Deploying the Skill
- Changing the skills target
- Healing the skill

talents.desc_zh:
使用精确射手步枪时，爆头将会使下一枪爆头伤害提升 80%，若下一枪爆头，则增加10%装甲（若此时装甲已满，将得到额外装甲，最大不超过装甲上限的 50%），若下一枪继续爆头，则填满弹匣。

从下一枪开始，若继续连续爆头，则每次都可得到上述三个奖励加成。若未能爆头则奖励重置。
talents.desc_en:
First Headshot with a MR will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a MR will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine.

From the 4th headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

talents.zh: 奥提兹焚烧机枪塔原型
talents.desc_zh:
焚烧机枪塔进行360度旋转。
玩家自身不会受到焚烧机枪塔的伤害。
焚烧机枪塔停用后爆炸。
talents.desc_en:
The Incinerator Turret spins 360°.
You are immune to your own Incinerator Turret’s fire.
The Incinerator Turret explodes when disabled.

talents.desc_zh:
充能中

战斗中，特工在掩体外每秒减少技能伤害 5%。最大为50%

 充能完成
充能完成后，免疫任何移动速度减益效果，并将其危害防护与技能伤害减免 与所有友军共享，持续 10 秒。

充能消耗后，若仍处于战斗状态且没有掩体，将继续获得充能中增益！
talents.desc_en:
Charging
For each second spent out of cover, during combat, Agents will get 5% reduced incoming skill damage. Max50%

Charged
While fully charged, gain immunity to any movement speed debuff and share this with all of the agent's hazard protection and the incoming skill damage reduction with all allies for 10 seconds.

After Charged is consumed, Charging buff will resume, if still in combat and out of cover!

talents.desc_zh:
每有一个瞄准该角色的敌人，则 +4% 伤害抵抗。最多叠加 8 层。
此加成会乘以 1.X 倍，X 是队伍中特工的数量。
talents.desc_en:
Get +4% Damage Resistance for every enemy that is targeting you. Max stack is 8.
The bonus is multiplied by 1.X, where X is the number of agents in your group.

talents.desc_zh:
使用步枪或精确射手步枪命中一次即可获得一层。最大层数等于武器的弹匣容量。装弹时，每层能 +2% 武器控制力以及 +4% 武器伤害，持续 20 秒。
获得加成后将不会累计层数。计时结束后会重新填满弹匣。
获得加成后，切换武器会停止效果并重新填满弹匣。未获得加成时，切换武器会移除所有层数并重新填满弹匣。
talents.desc_en:
Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Reloading will grant +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack, for 20s.
No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will refill your magazine.
Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine.

talents.desc_zh:
击杀 25 米外的敌人能够在 15 秒内提供 25% 的额外护甲，并使霰弹枪、冲锋枪和手枪 +40% 武器伤害，突击步枪和轻机枪 +20% 武器伤害。

击杀 25 米内的敌人能够在 15 秒内提供 +30% 爆头伤害，并使精确射手步枪和步枪 +40% 武器伤害，突击步枪和轻机枪 +20% 武器伤害。

交替在这两个范围内击杀敌人能够积累增益层数。在达到 4 层时，所有增益会同时触发且效果乘以 1.5，持续 15 秒，但此种增益在激活时无法积累层数。
talents.desc_en:
Killing an enemy further than 25m will provide +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns, SMG's and Pistols, +20% Weapon Damage to AR's and LMG's and 25% Bonus Armor for 15s.

Killing an enemy within 25m will provide +40% Weapon Damage to MMR's and Rifles, +20% Weapon Damage to AR's and LMG's and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s.

Intermittently killing enemies from both ranges will build up stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5 and triggered at the same time for 15s. No stacks are acquired while these bonuses are active.

talents.desc_zh:
获得相当于技能造成伤害 10% 的修复。
友军获得相当于技能造成伤害 20% 的修复。
talents.desc_en:
Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills.
Your allies receive repairs of 20% of the damage dealt by your Skills.

talents.desc_zh:
你的蜂窝或智能掩护范围内每有一位己方特工，则获得+1 技能分阶。
在达到技能分阶 6 时，蜂窝或智能掩护范围内有至少一位己方特工停留 4 秒后会获得 15 秒的超载效果。冷却时间：40 秒
进入你蜂窝或智能掩护范围内的迫击炮和敌方技能会被摧毁。冷却时间 10 秒。蜂窝或智能掩护范围内每有一位己方特工，则冷却时间加快 20%。
talents.desc_en:
Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent that is within the range of you Hive or Smart Cover.
While at Skill Tier 6, having at least one ally Agent in the range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4s will grant Overcharge for 15s Cooldown: 40s
Mortars and enemy Skills that enter the range of your Hive or Smart Cover will be destroyed. Cooldown 10s. The cooldown is 20% faster for each ally Agent within the range of your Hive or Smart Cover.

talents.desc_zh:
射击时最多能够叠加 50 层，每层使武器控制力 +0.5% 且暴击伤害 +5%。
停止射击后每秒损失 6 层。若敌方受到压制，则不会减少层数。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage.
Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.

talents.desc_zh:
射击敌人会同时将其标记，持续 10 秒。
被标记的敌人死亡时，每有一名盟友（包括自身在内）或技能物品协助完成过击杀，则获得一层 3% 的武器伤害和 3% 暴击伤害。

最大叠加 35 层。每 10 秒衰减一次。
最大标记数为 4。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting an enemy marks them for 10s.
When a marked enemy dies, receive one stack of 3% Weapon Damage and 3% Critical Hit Damage for each Ally or Skill that has contributed to killing that enemy, including yourself.

Max stacks is 35. Stacks decay every 10s.
Maximum amount of marks that can be placed is 4.

talents.desc_zh:
装备上每有一个核心，便获得另外两个核心加成的 40%。
获取此加成时，技能分阶按照 15% 技能效率进行计算。

除背包外的所有此套装的装备，都拥有随机核心。
talents.desc_en:
For each Core on your Gear Pieces, receive 40% of the other two Cores' bonuses.
Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when these bonuses are applied.

All pieces from this Gear Set, apart from the Backpack, will feature random Cores.

嘿，

凯尔在 217 室的苹果画旁边找到这些手套，他也在那里找到属于布莱德利的东西，因为他还在对那东西进行后续追踪，你可以先拿着这些手套。

Hey,

Kyle found these gloves in room 217, next to that painting of an apple. He found something belonging to Bradley in there as well, so since he's following up on that you can have these.

If you need to reach him leave a message with me.

-Rachel

talents.zh: 奥提兹迅捷应用纳米原型
talents.desc_zh:
治疗技能的持续时间和范围减少 90%，但其治疗效率提升 150%。

用技能治疗盟友时，会为其提供 30% 危害防护，持续 10 秒。
每名盟友的冷却时间：10 秒。
talents.desc_en:
Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%.

Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s.
Cooldown per ally: 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
命中被状态效果影响的敌人后会将其标记。

击杀标记的敌人会为自身使用中的武器填满空尖弹，并为其他队员使用中的武器装填一半相同子弹。

标记持续10秒。

空尖弹会提升 40% 武器伤害，并在命中时施加出血效果。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark.

Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of Hollow-Point Ammo for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party

Mark lasts for 10 seconds.

Hollow-Point Ammo amplifies weapon damage by 40% and applies bleed on hit.

如果最初施加的状态效果本身就是燃烧，则敌人会在燃烧持续时间内，受到 +25% 燃烧伤害。

If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive +25% Burn Damage for the duration of the Burn.

talents.desc_zh:
每隔 2 秒，被你击中的敌人会承受叠加的减益效果，有红色、白色与蓝色三种。

红色：该敌人受到的伤害增加 15%。

白色：射击该敌人每秒会修复攻击的特工 2% 装甲。

蓝色：使该敌人造成的伤害降低 10%。

旗帜飘扬：带着 3 种减益效果死亡的敌人会引发范围 5 米的爆炸，造成与其总生命值和装甲相同的伤害。（具名敌人死亡时爆炸伤害会减弱。）
talents.desc_en:
Every 2s, enemies you shoot receive a stacking debuff of Red, White and Blue.
 
Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%.
 
White: Shooting the enemy repairs the attacking agent’s armor by 2% once every second.
 
Blue: Decreases the enemy's damage dealt by 10%.
 
Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all 3 debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. (Explosion damage reduced on Named enemy deaths.)

sources.src_level_note: Positive selection pools; live availability unverified.
sources.note: 已找到掉落池定义，当前开放情况待确认

白色：射击该敌人每秒会修复攻击的特工 2% 装甲。

蓝色：使该敌人造成的伤害降低 10%。

旗帜飘扬：带着 3 种减益效果死亡的敌人会引发范围 5 米的爆炸，造成与其总生命值和装甲相同的伤害。（具名敌人死亡时爆炸伤害会减弱。）
talents.desc_en:
Every 2s, enemies you shoot receive a stacking debuff of Red, White and Blue.
 
Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%.
 
White: Shooting the enemy repairs the attacking agent’s armor by 2% once every second.
 
Blue: Decreases the enemy's damage dealt by 10%.
 
Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all 3 debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. (Explosion damage reduced on Named enemy deaths.)

talents.desc_zh:
每次使用或取消一项技能时，另一个技能的冷却时间将自动减少 30 秒，并增加 10% 的技能伤害和修复效果，持续 20 秒。

回馈回路每 10 秒可触发一次。
talents.desc_en:
Whenever you use or cancel a skill, your other skill’s cooldown is automatically reduced by 30s while increasing total skill damage and repair by 10% for 20s.

Feedback Loop can occur once every 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
暴击时会标记敌人 20 秒，最多标记 3 名敌人。

当你暴击一个受标记敌人时，其他被标记敌人全都会承受所造成暴击的 60% 伤害。

只要受标记敌人死亡，就会获得 +10% 的暴击伤害，最多叠加 10 次，或直到战斗结束。
talents.desc_en:
Critical hits mark enemies for 20s, up to 3 marks total.

When you critically hit a marked enemy, all other marked enemies take 60% of the damage dealt.

Whenever a marked enemy dies, gain +10% critical hit damage, stacking up to 10 times, or until combat ends.

sources.src_level_note: Positive selection pools; live availability unverified.

talents.desc_zh:
以步枪或精确射手步枪命中时可翻一次牌。

翻出 5 张牌后，下次命中时伤害将会增加 75%。翻出的手牌愈好，获得加成效果的子弹就愈多。

铁支：4 发子弹。

葫芦：3 发子弹。

死人之手（对A + 对8）：2 发子弹。

爆头时额外翻开一张卡牌。
talents.desc_en:
Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman Rifle. 

After 5 cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by 75%. More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed.

Four of a Kind: 4 shots.

Full House: 3 shots.

Aces and Eights: 2 shots.

Flip an additional card on headshots.

talents.desc_zh:
对 15 米内的敌人造成减益效果，提升 20% 你对他们造成的武器伤害。

使用你的武器击杀受受减益效果影响的敌人，可让 5 米内的其他敌人陷入混乱，并提升自身武器伤害 5%，持续 10 秒，最多叠加 5 次。
talents.desc_en:
Enemies within 15m receive a debuff, amplifying your weapon damage against them by 20%.

Killing a debuffed enemy with your weapon disorients other enemies within 5m, and amplifies weapon damage by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

Interactions include:
- Using / Deploying the Skill
- Changing the skills target
- Healing the skill

talents.en: From the Shadows Into the Light
talents.desc_zh:
在掩体后时，每秒获得 10 层叠加效果，最多可叠加至 50 层。每叠加一层，爆击伤害都将提高 1.2%，同时每分钟射速提高 0.4%。

从掩体后射击时，该增益不会生效。

走出掩体后，玩家以正常速度移动时每秒失去 2 层叠加效果，冲刺时每秒失去 1 层叠加效果。

在掩体外处于战斗状态时，每秒获得 10 层叠加效果，最多可叠加至 50 层。每一层效果被消耗时，都将回复玩家 0.8% 的装甲。
只有在掩体后时，该叠加效果才会以每秒 10 层的速度消耗。
talents.desc_en:
While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 1.2% Critical damage increase and 0.4%  RPM.

Buff does not apply while shooting from cover.

While out of cover Agents lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.

While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed.

Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover.

sources.src_level_note: Positive selection pools; live availability unverified.

talents.desc_zh:
使用精确射手步枪时，爆头将会使下一枪爆头伤害提升 80%，若下一枪爆头，则增加10%装甲（若此时装甲已满，将得到额外装甲，最大不超过装甲上限的 50%），若下一枪继续爆头，则填满弹匣。

从下一枪开始，若继续连续爆头，则每次都可得到上述三个奖励加成。若未能爆头则奖励重置。
talents.desc_en:
First Headshot with a MR will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a MR will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine.

From the 4th headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

sources.src_level_note: Positive selection pools; live availability unverified.

从下一枪开始，若继续连续爆头，则每次都可得到上述三个奖励加成。若未能爆头则奖励重置。
talents.desc_en:
First Headshot with a MR will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a MR will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine.

From the 4th headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

talents.desc_zh:
充能中

战斗中，特工在掩体外每秒减少技能伤害 5%。最大为50%

 充能完成
充能完成后，免疫任何移动速度减益效果，并将其危害防护与技能伤害减免 与所有友军共享，持续 10 秒。

充能消耗后，若仍处于战斗状态且没有掩体，将继续获得充能中增益！
talents.desc_en:
Charging
For each second spent out of cover, during combat, Agents will get 5% reduced incoming skill damage. Max50%

Charged
While fully charged, gain immunity to any movement speed debuff and share this with all of the agent's hazard protection and the incoming skill damage reduction with all allies for 10 seconds.

After Charged is consumed, Charging buff will resume, if still in combat and out of cover!

sources.src_level_note: Positive selection pools; live availability unverified.
sources.note: 已找到掉落池定义，当前开放情况待确认

充能完成后，免疫任何移动速度减益效果，并将其危害防护与技能伤害减免 与所有友军共享，持续 10 秒。

充能消耗后，若仍处于战斗状态且没有掩体，将继续获得充能中增益！

After Charged is consumed, Charging buff will resume, if still in combat and out of cover!

talents.desc_zh:
使用步枪或精确射手步枪命中一次即可获得一层。最大层数等于武器的弹匣容量。装弹时，每层能 +2% 武器控制力以及 +4% 武器伤害，持续 20 秒。
获得加成后将不会累计层数。计时结束后会重新填满弹匣。
获得加成后，切换武器会停止效果并重新填满弹匣。未获得加成时，切换武器会移除所有层数并重新填满弹匣。
talents.desc_en:
Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Reloading will grant +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack, for 20s.
No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will refill your magazine.
Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine.

sources.src_level_note: Positive selection pools; live availability unverified.

talents.desc_zh:
击杀 25 米外的敌人能够在 15 秒内提供 25% 的额外护甲，并使霰弹枪、冲锋枪和手枪 +40% 武器伤害，突击步枪和轻机枪 +20% 武器伤害。

击杀 25 米内的敌人能够在 15 秒内提供 +30% 爆头伤害，并使精确射手步枪和步枪 +40% 武器伤害，突击步枪和轻机枪 +20% 武器伤害。

交替在这两个范围内击杀敌人能够积累增益层数。在达到 4 层时，所有增益会同时触发且效果乘以 1.5，持续 15 秒，但此种增益在激活时无法积累层数。
talents.desc_en:
Killing an enemy further than 25m will provide +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns, SMG's and Pistols, +20% Weapon Damage to AR's and LMG's and 25% Bonus Armor for 15s.

Killing an enemy within 25m will provide +40% Weapon Damage to MMR's and Rifles, +20% Weapon Damage to AR's and LMG's and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s.

Intermittently killing enemies from both ranges will build up stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5 and triggered at the same time for 15s. No stacks are acquired while these bonuses are active.

sources.src_level_note: Positive selection pools; live availability unverified.

talents.desc_en:
Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage.
Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.

talents.desc_zh:
射击敌人会同时将其标记，持续 10 秒。
被标记的敌人死亡时，每有一名盟友（包括自身在内）或技能物品协助完成过击杀，则获得一层 3% 的武器伤害和 3% 暴击伤害。

最大叠加 35 层。每 10 秒衰减一次。
最大标记数为 4。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting an enemy marks them for 10s.
When a marked enemy dies, receive one stack of 3% Weapon Damage and 3% Critical Hit Damage for each Ally or Skill that has contributed to killing that enemy, including yourself.

Max stacks is 35. Stacks decay every 10s.
Maximum amount of marks that can be placed is 4.

Max stacks is 35. Stacks decay every 10s.
Maximum amount of marks that can be placed is 4.

During a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for {10}s.

During a Full Moon, deploying a Decoy will grant it Overcharge and the cycle will pause for 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
命中被状态效果影响的敌人后会将其标记。

击杀标记的敌人会为自身使用中的武器填满空尖弹，并为其他队员使用中的武器装填一半相同子弹。

标记持续10秒。

空尖弹会提升 40% 武器伤害，并在命中时施加出血效果。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting a status affected enemy will apply a mark.

Killing a marked enemy grants a full clip of Hollow-Point Ammo for your active weapon, and half a clip of the agent's active weapon to the rest of the party

Mark lasts for 10 seconds.

Hollow-Point Ammo amplifies weapon damage by 40% and applies bleed on hit.

talents.zh: 奥提兹迅捷应用纳米原型
talents.desc_zh:
治疗技能的持续时间和范围减少 90%，但其治疗效率提升 150%。

用技能治疗盟友时，会为其提供 30% 危害防护，持续 10 秒。
每名盟友的冷却时间：10 秒。
talents.desc_en:
Healing Skills' Duration and Range are decreased by 90%, but their Healing Efficiency is increased by 150%.

Healing an Ally with a Skill will provide them 30% Hazard Protection for 10s.
Cooldown per ally: 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
每隔 2 秒，被你击中的敌人会承受叠加的减益效果，有红色、白色与蓝色三种。

红色：该敌人受到的伤害增加 15%。

白色：射击该敌人每秒会修复攻击的特工 2% 装甲。

蓝色：使该敌人造成的伤害降低 10%。

旗帜飘扬：带着 3 种减益效果死亡的敌人会引发范围 5 米的爆炸，造成与其总生命值和装甲相同的伤害。（具名敌人死亡时爆炸伤害会减弱。）
talents.desc_en:
Every 2s, enemies you shoot receive a stacking debuff of Red, White and Blue.
 
Red: Amplifies the enemy's damage taken by 15%.
 
White: Shooting the enemy repairs the attacking agent’s armor by 2% once every second.
 
Blue: Decreases the enemy's damage dealt by 10%.
 
Full Flag: Enemies that die while under the effect of all 3 debuffs create a 5m explosion, dealing damage equal to their total health and armor. (Explosion damage reduced on Named enemy deaths.)

talents.desc_zh:
每次施加状态效果都有 40% 概率也同时对敌人施加燃烧效果。

如果最初施加的状态效果本身就是燃烧，则敌人会在燃烧持续时间内，受到 +25% 燃烧伤害。
talents.desc_en:
Every Status Effect you apply has a 40% chance of also applying Burn to the enemy.

If the Status Effect initially applied was Burn, the enemy will receive +25% Burn Damage for the duration of the Burn.

talents.desc_zh:
每次使用或取消一项技能时，另一个技能的冷却时间将自动减少 30 秒，并增加 10% 的技能伤害和修复效果，持续 20 秒。

回馈回路每 10 秒可触发一次。
talents.desc_en:
Whenever you use or cancel a skill, your other skill’s cooldown is automatically reduced by 30s while increasing total skill damage and repair by 10% for 20s.

Feedback Loop can occur once every 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
暴击时会标记敌人 20 秒，最多标记 3 名敌人。

当你暴击一个受标记敌人时，其他被标记敌人全都会承受所造成暴击的 60% 伤害。

只要受标记敌人死亡，就会获得 +10% 的暴击伤害，最多叠加 10 次，或直到战斗结束。
talents.desc_en:
Critical hits mark enemies for 20s, up to 3 marks total.

When you critically hit a marked enemy, all other marked enemies take 60% of the damage dealt.

Whenever a marked enemy dies, gain +10% critical hit damage, stacking up to 10 times, or until combat ends.

talents.desc_zh:
使用特有武器击杀后会增加 15% 的特有武器伤害，持续 10 秒，并且此武器的下一次换弹时 +25% 换弹速度（加成效果不叠加）。

每 60 秒自动补充特有武器弹药。
talents.desc_en:
Getting a Signature Weapon kill gives +15% Signature Weapon Damage for 10s and +25% Reload Speed for the next reload of the weapon (the bonuses do not stack).

Automatically regenerate Signature Weapon Ammo every 60s.

talents.desc_zh:
以步枪或精确射手步枪命中时可翻一次牌。

翻出 5 张牌后，下次命中时伤害将会增加 75%。翻出的手牌愈好，获得加成效果的子弹就愈多。

铁支：4 发子弹。

葫芦：3 发子弹。

死人之手（对A + 对8）：2 发子弹。

爆头时额外翻开一张卡牌。
talents.desc_en:
Flip a card when landing shots with a Rifle or Marksman Rifle. 

After 5 cards are flipped, the damage of your next shot is amplified by 75%. More shots are enhanced the better the hand revealed.

Four of a Kind: 4 shots.

Full House: 3 shots.

Aces and Eights: 2 shots.

Flip an additional card on headshots.

talents.desc_zh:
以一个可以瞬间使用且无限次数的技能替换装甲包，技能效果为修复 20% 装甲，赋予 50% 加成装甲并隐藏你的名条 5 秒，而此技能冷却时间为 20 秒。

每获得 5% 加成装甲，总武器伤害即增加 2%，最多可达 20%。
talents.desc_en:
Replaces armor kits with an instant, infinite-use ability on a 20s cooldown, that repairs 20% armor, grants 50% bonus armor and hides your nameplate for 5s.

Increases total weapon damage by 2% per 5% bonus armor gained, up to 20%.

talents.desc_zh: 无论你或护盾受到伤害时，伤害量的 25% 可于 10 秒内回复。
talents.desc_en: Whenever you or your shield take damage, 25% of that amount is repaired to both over 10s.

talents.desc_zh:
装甲全满的你和友军可增加 15% 的总武器伤害和技能伤害。

当你为一位友军修复装甲时，你和 5 米范围内的友军也会同时获得 60% 的修复效果。
talents.desc_en:
Increases you and your allies' total weapon and skill damage by 15% when at full armor.  

When you repair an ally, you and all allies within 5m of you are also repaired for 60% of that amount.

talents.desc_zh:
每次使用武器命中目标便会增加 0.65% 总 武器伤害 ，最多可叠加 100 次。

若层数为0 到 50，则每秒会失去 1 层叠加效果。
若层数为50 到 100，则每秒会失去 2 层叠加效果。
talents.desc_en:
Weapon hits increase total weapon damage by 0.65%, stacking up to 100 times.

1 stacks lost per second between 0 and 50 stacks
2 stacks lost per second between 50 and 100 stacks

talents.desc_zh: 你的状态效果会在造成击杀时扩散至 10 米内的所有敌人身上，并重置 50% 的持续时间。
talents.desc_en: Your status effects now spread on kill to all enemies within 10m and refresh 50% of the duration.

talents.desc_zh:
对 15 米内的敌人造成减益效果，提升 20% 你对他们造成的武器伤害。

使用你的武器击杀受受减益效果影响的敌人，可让 5 米内的其他敌人陷入混乱，并提升自身武器伤害 5%，持续 10 秒，最多叠加 5 次。
talents.desc_en:
Enemies within 15m receive a debuff, amplifying your weapon damage against them by 20%.

Killing a debuffed enemy with your weapon disorients other enemies within 5m, and amplifies weapon damage by 5% for 10s, stacking up to 5 times.

talents.desc_zh:
与自已部署的技能对象互动可使之获得 25% 的技能伤害，持续 10 秒。此增益无法刷新。

互动内容包含：
- 使用或部署技能
- 更改技能的目标
- 修复技能对象
talents.desc_en:
Interacting with your deployed skills grants the skill 25% skill damage for 10s. This buff cannot be refreshed.

Interactions include:
- Using / Deploying the Skill
- Changing the skills target
- Healing the skill

talents.en: From the Shadows Into the Light
talents.desc_zh:
在掩体后时，每秒获得 10 层叠加效果，最多可叠加至 50 层。每叠加一层，爆击伤害都将提高 1.2%，同时每分钟射速提高 0.4%。

从掩体后射击时，该增益不会生效。

走出掩体后，玩家以正常速度移动时每秒失去 2 层叠加效果，冲刺时每秒失去 1 层叠加效果。

在掩体外处于战斗状态时，每秒获得 10 层叠加效果，最多可叠加至 50 层。每一层效果被消耗时，都将回复玩家 0.8% 的装甲。
只有在掩体后时，该叠加效果才会以每秒 10 层的速度消耗。
talents.desc_en:
While in cover, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 1.2% Critical damage increase and 0.4%  RPM.

Buff does not apply while shooting from cover.

While out of cover Agents lose 2 stacks per second at normal speed and 1 stack per second if sprinting.

While out of cover and in combat, gain 10 Stacks per second up to 50. Each stack will give 0.8% Armor regen when it is consumed.

Stacks consume, 10 stacks per second, only in cover.

talents.desc_zh:
使用精确射手步枪时，爆头将会使下一枪爆头伤害提升 80%，若下一枪爆头，则增加10%装甲（若此时装甲已满，将得到额外装甲，最大不超过装甲上限的 50%），若下一枪继续爆头，则填满弹匣。

从下一枪开始，若继续连续爆头，则每次都可得到上述三个奖励加成。若未能爆头则奖励重置。
talents.desc_en:
First Headshot with a MR will increase next headshot by 80%, second consecutive headshot with a MR will give +10% armor (if at full armor it will give bonus armor max +50% of current armor value), third consecutive headshot will refill magazine.

From the 4th headshot forward agents will get all 3 bonuses for each consecutive headshot kill. Missing a headshot will reset the cycle.

talents.zh: 奥提兹焚烧机枪塔原型
talents.desc_zh:
焚烧机枪塔进行360度旋转。
玩家自身不会受到焚烧机枪塔的伤害。
焚烧机枪塔停用后爆炸。
talents.desc_en:
The Incinerator Turret spins 360°.
You are immune to your own Incinerator Turret’s fire.
The Incinerator Turret explodes when disabled.

talents.desc_zh:
充能中

战斗中，特工在掩体外每秒减少技能伤害 5%。最大为50%

 充能完成
充能完成后，免疫任何移动速度减益效果，并将其危害防护与技能伤害减免 与所有友军共享，持续 10 秒。

充能消耗后，若仍处于战斗状态且没有掩体，将继续获得充能中增益！
talents.desc_en:
Charging
For each second spent out of cover, during combat, Agents will get 5% reduced incoming skill damage. Max50%

Charged
While fully charged, gain immunity to any movement speed debuff and share this with all of the agent's hazard protection and the incoming skill damage reduction with all allies for 10 seconds.

After Charged is consumed, Charging buff will resume, if still in combat and out of cover!

talents.desc_zh:
每有一个瞄准该角色的敌人，则 +4% 伤害抵抗。最多叠加 8 层。
此加成会乘以 1.X 倍，X 是队伍中特工的数量。
talents.desc_en:
Get +4% Damage Resistance for every enemy that is targeting you. Max stack is 8.
The bonus is multiplied by 1.X, where X is the number of agents in your group.

talents.desc_zh:
使用步枪或精确射手步枪命中一次即可获得一层。最大层数等于武器的弹匣容量。装弹时，每层能 +2% 武器控制力以及 +4% 武器伤害，持续 20 秒。
获得加成后将不会累计层数。计时结束后会重新填满弹匣。
获得加成后，切换武器会停止效果并重新填满弹匣。未获得加成时，切换武器会移除所有层数并重新填满弹匣。
talents.desc_en:
Hitting a shot with a Rifle or MMR grants a stack. Max stack is equal to the weapon's Magazine Size. Reloading will grant +2% Weapon Handling and +4% Weapon Damage per stack, for 20s.
No stacks are acquired while the bonuses are active. The timer running out will refill your magazine.
Switching weapons while the bonuses are active will stop the effect and refill your magazine. Switching weapons while the bonuses are not active will remove all stacks and refill your magazine.

talents.desc_zh:
击杀 25 米外的敌人能够在 15 秒内提供 25% 的额外护甲，并使霰弹枪、冲锋枪和手枪 +40% 武器伤害，突击步枪和轻机枪 +20% 武器伤害。

击杀 25 米内的敌人能够在 15 秒内提供 +30% 爆头伤害，并使精确射手步枪和步枪 +40% 武器伤害，突击步枪和轻机枪 +20% 武器伤害。

交替在这两个范围内击杀敌人能够积累增益层数。在达到 4 层时，所有增益会同时触发且效果乘以 1.5，持续 15 秒，但此种增益在激活时无法积累层数。
talents.desc_en:
Killing an enemy further than 25m will provide +40% Weapon Damage to Shotguns, SMG's and Pistols, +20% Weapon Damage to AR's and LMG's and 25% Bonus Armor for 15s.

Killing an enemy within 25m will provide +40% Weapon Damage to MMR's and Rifles, +20% Weapon Damage to AR's and LMG's and +30% Headshot Damage for 15s.

Intermittently killing enemies from both ranges will build up stacks. At 4 stacks, all bonuses are multiplied by 1.5 and triggered at the same time for 15s. No stacks are acquired while these bonuses are active.

talents.desc_zh:
获得相当于技能造成伤害 10% 的修复。
友军获得相当于技能造成伤害 20% 的修复。
talents.desc_en:
Receive repairs of 10% of the damage dealt by your Skills.
Your allies receive repairs of 20% of the damage dealt by your Skills.

talents.desc_zh:
你的蜂窝或智能掩护范围内每有一位己方特工，则获得+1 技能分阶。
在达到技能分阶 6 时，蜂窝或智能掩护范围内有至少一位己方特工停留 4 秒后会获得 15 秒的超载效果。冷却时间：40 秒
进入你蜂窝或智能掩护范围内的迫击炮和敌方技能会被摧毁。冷却时间 10 秒。蜂窝或智能掩护范围内每有一位己方特工，则冷却时间加快 20%。
talents.desc_en:
Receive +1 Skill Tier for each ally Agent that is within the range of you Hive or Smart Cover.
While at Skill Tier 6, having at least one ally Agent in the range of your Hive or Smart Cover for 4s will grant Overcharge for 15s Cooldown: 40s
Mortars and enemy Skills that enter the range of your Hive or Smart Cover will be destroyed. Cooldown 10s. The cooldown is 20% faster for each ally Agent within the range of your Hive or Smart Cover.

talents.desc_zh:
射击时最多能够叠加 50 层，每层使武器控制力 +0.5% 且暴击伤害 +5%。
停止射击后每秒损失 6 层。若敌方受到压制，则不会减少层数。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting builds stacks to a max of 50. Each stack provides +0.5% Weapon Handling and +5% Critical Hit Damage.
Lose 6 stacks per second while not shooting. No stacks are lost if an enemy is Suppressed.

talents.desc_zh:
射击敌人会同时将其标记，持续 10 秒。
被标记的敌人死亡时，每有一名盟友（包括自身在内）或技能物品协助完成过击杀，则获得一层 3% 的武器伤害和 3% 暴击伤害。

最大叠加 35 层。每 10 秒衰减一次。
最大标记数为 4。
talents.desc_en:
Shooting an enemy marks them for 10s.
When a marked enemy dies, receive one stack of 3% Weapon Damage and 3% Critical Hit Damage for each Ally or Skill that has contributed to killing that enemy, including yourself.

Max stacks is 35. Stacks decay every 10s.
Maximum amount of marks that can be placed is 4.

talents.desc_zh:
装备上每有一个核心，便获得另外两个核心加成的 40%。
获取此加成时，技能分阶按照 15% 技能效率进行计算。

除背包外的所有此套装的装备，都拥有随机核心。
talents.desc_en:
For each Core on your Gear Pieces, receive 40% of the other two Cores' bonuses.
Skill Tiers count as 15% Skill Efficiency when these bonuses are applied.

All pieces from this Gear Set, apart from the Backpack, will feature random Cores.

specializations.formula: specops_allskills_cooldown_mod_bonus * max( 3, Sticky_explosive_cooldown_Base * (1/(1 + Sticky_explosive_cooldown_mod_Bonus + Sticky_platform_cooldown_mod_Bonus)) * (1/(1 + allskills_cooldown_mod_Bonus)))

variants.name: 破片
variants.desc_zh: 破片陷阱会散布能附著于任意表面（甚至是敌人）的小型爆炸设备，并在敌人接近时引爆。
variants.desc_en: The Shrapnel Trap scatters a minefield of small explosive devices that can attach to any surface (including enemies) and then detonate based on enemy proximity.

specializations.name: Is in Specops
specializations.formula: specops_allskills_cooldown_mod_bonus * max( 3, Trap_Explosive_cooldown_Base * (1/(1 + Trap_Explosive_cooldown_mod_Bonus + Trap_Platform_cooldown_mod_Bonus)) * (1/(1 + allskills_cooldown_mod_Bonus)))

base_stats.formula: Trap_explosive_damage_Base * SkillCurveFinal * ( 1 + Trap_explosive_damage_mod_Bonus + Trap_platform_damage_mod_Bonus )  * ( 1 + allskills_damage_mod_Bonus ) * ( 1 + BlastDamageModBonus ) * ( 1 + GearTalentAllSkillsDamageModBonus )

variants.name: 修复
variants.desc_zh:
修复陷阱会在一块区域上布满小型设备，修复任何接近的友军。

冷却时间会在陷阱失效时减少。
variants.desc_en:
The Repair Trap scatters a minefield of small devices capable of repairing friendlies in their proximity.

Cooldown reduced when traps expire.

specializations.name: Is in Specops
specializations.formula: specops_allskills_cooldown_mod_bonus * max( 3, Trap_Repair_Cooldown_Base * (1/(1 + Trap_Repair_Cooldown_Mod_Bonus + Trap_Platform_cooldown_mod_Bonus)) * (1/(1 + allskills_cooldown_mod_Bonus)))

variants.name: 电击陷阱
variants.desc_zh:
电击陷阱会在一块区域上布满小型设备，任何进到范围内的目标都会受到电击。

冷却时间会在陷阱失效时减少。
variants.desc_en:
The Shock Trap scatters a minefield of small devices capable of shocking targets moving in their proximity.

Cooldown reduced when traps expire.

specializations.name: Is in Specops
specializations.formula: specops_allskills_cooldown_mod_bonus * max( 3, Trap_Shock_cooldown_Base * (1/(1 + Trap_Shock_cooldown_mod_Bonus + Trap_Platform_cooldown_mod_Bonus)) * (1/(1 + allskills_cooldown_mod_Bonus)))

grenades.name: Cluster Grenade
grenades.desc_zh: 集束手雷会发射小型手雷，造成大范围爆破。虽然遭《集束弹药公约》明确禁止，但美国并未签约。
grenades.desc_en: The cluster grenade launches mini grenades which detonate in a large area of effect. Use is expressly prohibited by the CCM, though the United States is not a signatory party.

grenades.name: 镇暴泡沫手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 镇暴泡沫手雷可以诱捕敌人。
grenades.desc_en: The Riot Foam Grenade ensnares enemies.

grenades.name: 震荡手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 准确投掷时，震荡手雷可造成大量伤害。
grenades.desc_en: The concussion grenade deals massive damage on accurate throws.

grenades.name: 电磁脉冲手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 电磁脉冲手雷可对有效范围内的所有电子能力造成干扰。
grenades.desc_en: The EMP grenade applies disrupt to all electrical abilities within the affected area.

grenades.name: 闪光手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 闪光手雷可用来致盲广大效果范围内的所有目标。
grenades.desc_en: The flashbang grenade applies blind to all targets within a large area of effect.

grenades.name: 破片手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 破片手雷能对目标造成伤害，并使目标出血。
grenades.desc_en: The fragmentation grenade deals damage and causes targets to bleed.

grenades.name: 燃烧手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 燃烧手雷可用来使范围内的目标燃烧。
grenades.desc_en: The incendiary grenade applies burn to targets within the radius.

grenades.name: 电击手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 电击手雷可造成电击状态效果。
grenades.desc_en: The shock grenade applies the shock status effect.

grenades.name: 催泪瓦斯手雷
grenades.desc_zh: 催泪瓦斯手雷可造成困惑状态效果。
grenades.desc_en: The tear gas grenade applies the confuse status effect.

blueprints.desc_zh:
“我不会寻求复仇行动的许可。我只会直接复仇，有必要的话，再寻求原谅。我打从心底尊重混乱的产生。”

—“淘气鬼”
blueprints.desc_en:
"I do not seek permission for acts of retribution. I simply perform, and if required, ask forgiveness. I truly honor the spawn of Nyx."

 – Puck

blueprints.zh: 哈维尔·卡吉卡的王子左轮手枪设计图
blueprints.desc_zh: “卡吉卡的王子左轮手枪是独一无二的，但只要有正确的零件跟材料，就可以弄出一模一样的手枪。”——依娜亚
blueprints.desc_en: “Kajika's Regulus revolver is one of a kind, but with the right parts and materials, we can make it two of a kind.” - Inaya

blueprints.desc_zh: “闭上嘴，让你的枪负责讲话。”
blueprints.desc_en: "Zip it and let your gun do the talking."

blueprints.desc_zh:
匆忙写下的消息：
“嘿，肯卓。感谢你的帮忙。我们聊完后，我对图样做了些调整。原本我对于你一开始的建议不是很确定（考虑到来源），不过它们都兜在一起了。
再次感谢。”
——希瑞·T. C.
blueprints.desc_en:
Hastily scribbled message:
"Hey Kendra. Thanks for the help. I've made some adjustments to the schematic after our talk. I wasn't sure about your initial suggestions (considering the source), but they all came together.
Thanks, again."
- Siri T. C.

note: 只记满甲时悉数奉还附带的额外护甲上限。修复量不乘进去。
Only the bonus-armor cap added by skill repair at full armor is recorded. Repair amount is not multiplied in.
只记对受干扰目标的伤害。抗性、脉冲半径和冷却不进子弹。
Only damage against disrupted targets is recorded. Resistance, pulse radius, and cooldown are not bullet damage.
只记红色减益让该敌人受到的额外伤害。白旗回复和蓝旗降伤不进子弹。
Only the red debuff's extra damage taken by that enemy is recorded. White repair and blue damage reduction are not bullet damage.
只记提高后的核心转换率。核心数量不乘进去，四件套的直接伤害不重复。
Only the raised core conversion rate is recorded. Core count is not multiplied in, and the four-piece direct damage is not added again.
只记每个核心直接给的武器伤害和技能效率。核心转换率不乘进另一段面板。
Only the weapon damage and skill efficiency given directly per core are recorded. The core conversion rate is not multiplied into another panel value.
只记技能伤害转回复的官方百分比。不把技能伤害乘进去，友军部分不进自身。
Only the official percent of skill damage converted to repair is recorded. Skill damage is not multiplied in, and the ally portion is separate.
只记受到伤害后回复的官方百分比。胸甲只加自己的增量，回复秒数不模拟。
Only the official percent of damage taken that is repaired is recorded. The chest adds its own increment. Repair seconds are not simulated.
只记击杀后的状态扩散范围。重置持续时间的百分比不进伤害。
Only the status spread range after a kill is recorded. The duration refresh percent is not damage.
翻完牌后的伤害只对接下来几发生效，不进整匣伤害。牌型决定发数，不在这里相加。
Damage after the cards resolve applies only to the next shots, not the whole magazine. The hand decides the shot count and is not added here.
对受脉冲影响的目标按满层计入。胸甲只提高层数上限。额外护甲不在这里。
Damage against pulsed targets is counted at full stacks. The chest only raises the stack cap. Bonus armor is separate.
满甲时的队伍增益：总武伤和总技能伤害各自入池，不能把总技能伤害并入基础技能伤害。胸甲增量各合入一次。
Full-armor group buff: separate total-weapon and total-skill pools. Total skill damage is not base skill damage. The chest increment is merged once in each pool.
标记死亡叠层只增加暴伤。60%/背包112%是向其他标记目标复制暴击伤害的比例，不是当前目标的武器增伤；多目标合计未模拟。
Marked kills stack CHD. The 60% / backpack 112% values transfer critical damage to OTHER marked enemies; they do not amplify the primary target. Aggregate multi-target damage is not modeled.
只计入 4 件套本身的两项。胸甲和背包是另一段加成，不在这里相加。
Only the 4-piece handling and weapon damage are counted. Chest and backpack are separate bonuses.
只取没有界面后缀的那条武器伤害。带 UI 的两条是说明用区间，不重复计入。
Only the weapon-damage row without a UI suffix is counted. The two UI rows are display ranges and are not added again.
只取背包自己的每层暴击伤害。带 UI 的两条是说明用区间，不重复计入。
Only the backpack's own critical-hit damage per stack is counted. The two UI rows are display ranges and are not added again.
只计掩体内的暴击与射速两行。出掩体那一半是「每消耗一层回 0.8% 装甲」，与掩体内两行共用同一个层数上限、两段又互斥，同时计会双算 ⇒ 不进本行。背包那条（投明）抬的是出掩体段的层数上限，所以也没有可挂的入参。

Only the in-cover critical-damage and rate-of-fire rows are recorded. The out-of-cover half regenerates 0.8% armor per stack consumed; it shares the same stack limit and the two phases are mutually exclusive, so counting both would double the cap. The backpack talent raises the out-of-cover limit and therefore has no input to attach to.
减益目标的增伤是常数。击杀后的武器伤害按满层计入。距离、混乱和持续时间不模拟。
Damage against debuffed targets is a constant. Weapon damage after a kill is counted at full stacks. Distance, disorient and duration are not simulated.
只计入使用或取消技能后的技能伤害和修复。冷却缩减不模拟，不进枪械伤害。胸甲是增量。
Only skill damage and repair after using or cancelling a skill are counted. Cooldown reduction is not simulated, and it is not firearm damage. The chest is an increment.
与部署技能互动后，伤害进入技能平台池（炮塔/突击无人机参考模型），不与装备技能伤害相加。胸甲增量仅合入一次；10秒内不可刷新，不代表持续覆盖。

Interaction buffs the platform pool in the turret/assault-drone reference model, separately from gear skill damage. The chest increment is merged once. The 10-second buff cannot refresh; this is not sustained uptime.
治疗效率按 4 件常数计入。危害防护只在治疗队友后计入。范围和持续时间不模拟。胸甲另有自己的治疗增量。
Healing efficiency uses the 4-piece constant. Hazard protection counts only after healing an ally. Range and duration are not simulated. The chest has its own healing increment.
只计入对处于状态效果的目标的增伤。状态扩散本身不模拟。
Only the damage bonus against targets under a status effect is counted. Status spread itself is not simulated.
武器伤害按满层。额外护甲只计护甲包比例，背包只加自己的增量。隐藏名条和甲量曲线不模拟。
Weapon damage is counted at full stacks. Bonus armor counts only the armor-kit portion, and the backpack adds only its own increment. The hidden nameplate and armor curve are not simulated.
只取胸甲自己的专属武器伤害增量。带界面后缀的两条是说明用区间，不重复计入。
Only the chest's own signature-weapon damage increment is counted. The two interface rows are display ranges and are not added again.
只计入专属弹药耗尽后的武器伤害。持续时间与弹药加倍不模拟。
Only weapon damage after signature ammo is depleted is counted. Duration and doubled ammo are not simulated.
只计入出血伤害。出血持续时间不进枪械子弹。
Only bleed damage is counted. Bleed duration is not firearm damage.
只在最初状态本身就是燃烧时计入额外燃烧伤害。几率不在这里。
Only extra burn damage is counted when the original status is already burn. Chance is separate.
只按被瞄准人数上限计入减伤。背包加每名敌人的百分点。队伍人数倍率和诱饵不在这里。
Only damage reduction at the enemy-aim cap is counted. The backpack adds its per-enemy increment. Party multiplier and decoys are separate.
只按充能完成后的技能伤害减免上限计入。移速免疫、每秒充能和背包的每秒保护不在这里。
Only the charged skill-damage reduction cap is counted. Movement immunity, the per-second charge, and the backpack's per-second protection are separate.
只在保持爆头时计入下一枪的爆头独立增伤。它只乘爆头本体，不进爆头伤词条。连续爆头给的装甲、额外护甲和填满弹匣不在这里。

Only the next shot's headshot amplify is counted while headshots continue. It multiplies the headshot itself and is not a headshot-damage stat. Armor, bonus armor and the magazine refill from further headshots are separate.
只计入胸甲自己的伤害增量。牌型和发数不在这里。
Only the chest's own damage increment is counted. Card hands and shot counts are separate.
只计入近距爆炸治疗的背包增量。界面区间不重复计入。
Only the backpack's close-blast repair increment is counted. Interface ranges are not added again.
只计入点燃敌人的武器伤害。炮台射程不在这里。
Only weapon damage against ignited enemies is counted. Turret range is separate.
只计入专属武器击杀后的下一次换弹。不叠加。
Only the next reload after a signature-weapon kill is counted. It does not stack.
玩家增益子图目标UID为 WeaponDamageModBonus 和 WeaponCriticalHitDamageFlatBonus：武器伤害进基础池，不是总武器伤害。满层需标记敌人死亡及友军/技能参与；背包只加武伤增量。

The player-buff subgraph targets WeaponDamageModBonus and WeaponCriticalHitDamageFlatBonus: base weapon damage, not total weapon damage. Maximum stacks require marked-enemy kills and ally/skill contributions; the backpack adds only its weapon-damage increment.
只记背包额外的白旗回复和蓝旗降伤。红色已经在父规则里。
Only the backpack's extra white-flag repair and blue-flag damage reduction are recorded. Red is already on the parent rule.
只记背包额外增加的混乱范围。基础范围不另加。
Only the extra disorient range added by the backpack is recorded. The base range is not added again.
只记胸甲额外增加的电磁脉冲范围。基础范围不另加。
Only the extra EMP range added by the chest is recorded. The base range is not added again.
只记点燃后向周围敌人扩散的范围。不进爆炸伤害。
Only the range that spreads fire to nearby enemies is recorded. It is not explosion damage.
只记机枪塔停用后的爆炸伤害上限。最低伤害和范围不另加。
Only the explosion-damage cap after the turret shuts down is recorded. Minimum damage and radius are not added again.
只记燃烧持续时间加成。燃烧伤害是 0，不另加。
Only the burn-duration bonus is recorded. Burn damage is zero and is not added again.
只记背包把持续时间减益补回的部分。基础减益和范围不另加。
Only the duration debuff restored by the backpack is recorded. The base debuff and range are not added again.
只取胸甲自己的治疗效率。带 UI 的两条是说明用区间，不重复计入。
Only the chest's own healing increase is counted. The two UI rows are display ranges and are not added again.
只取当前武器对应的伤害。步枪和射手步枪同时取近距爆头；护甲和满层倍率不在这里。
Only the current weapon's damage is counted. Rifles and marksman rifles also take the close-range headshot bonus. Armor and the full-stack multiplier are separate.
只记胸甲把额外护甲上限提高的增量。界面区间不另加，下一枪爆头仍由档位层计算。
Only the chest's bonus-armor cap increment is recorded. Interface ranges are not added again. The next headshot stays on the tier layer.
只记持续时间增量，不进武器伤害。
Only the duration increment is recorded. It is not weapon damage.
只记回复速度变化。负值表示更快，不进武器伤害。
Only the repair timing change is recorded. A negative value means faster. It is not weapon damage.
冷却缩短记到技能加速。负值表示缩短，不进武器伤害。
Cooldown reduction is recorded as skill haste. A negative value means shorter. It is not weapon damage.
只记叠加持续时间增量。
Only the stack-duration increment is recorded.
燃烧几率记到状态效果，不进武器伤害。
Burn chance is recorded as status effects. It is not weapon damage.
护甲包冷却缩短记到技能加速。
Armor-kit cooldown reduction is recorded as skill haste.
只记每位友军提供的冷却加快。技能分阶和超载不在这里。
Only cooldown reduction per ally is recorded. Skill tier and overcharge are separate.
摧毁敌方技能的冷却缩短记到技能加速。
Enemy-skill destruction cooldown is recorded as skill haste.
超载冷却缩短记到技能加速。
Overcharge cooldown reduction is recorded as skill haste.
颜色旋转加快记到技能加速。
Faster color rotation is recorded as skill haste.
只记三色敌人波及附近敌人的伤害。半径不进子弹。
Only the splash damage from a three-color enemy is recorded. Radius is not bullet damage.
目标充足环境（谈判者胸甲）：官方参数 markamount +2 ⇒ 标记数 3→5。这是**目标数量**增益，不进伤害乘区，只落展示字段「标记数量」。
Target Rich Environment (ND chest): official markamount +2 (3 to 5). Target-count gain, not a damage multiplier; shown as the MarkAmount field only.
人人为我（专注连队胸甲）：官方参数 max_number_of_enemies_marked 4 ⇒ 可标记敌人 4→8。同样是**目标数量**增益，不进伤害乘区。
One for All (Concentrated Company chest): official max marked enemies 4 (4 to 8). Target-count gain, not a damage multiplier.
袖中王牌：官方只给了 shots_UI = 1（强化 1 次额外射击）与三个花色标记位。引擎没有「强化射击」字段，硬塞进「接下来几发伤害%」会把一次射击说成伤害加成 ⇒ 按可数不可计留白。

Ace in the Sleeve (A8 backpack): official data only has shots_UI = 1 plus suit flags. No modelled field for an empowered shot; mapping it to next-shot damage would state one shot as a damage bonus, so it stays uncounted.
完整上线：官方只有一个 equipped 标记（取消技能可重置冷却）。没有可计数值 ⇒ 不计入。
Complete Uptime (Minionmancer backpack): only an equipped flag exists. Nothing countable.
幸运之人：官方参数 can_miss_once = 1（爆头失败一次也不重置）。这是**覆盖率**类增益，引擎目前只有武器天赋那一条 cov 通路 ⇒ 不计入，等覆盖率口径统一后再接。
Blessed (Hotshot backpack): can_miss_once = 1 is a coverage gain, not a value. Pending the coverage calibre.
欺瞒：官方参数只有 talent_active = 1（诱饵敌人计入坚忍减伤计算）。机制类、无数值 ⇒ 不计入。
Deceit (Stoic chest): only an active flag; mechanical, no value.
外部核心：官方 bonus 为空（文案是「此背包拥有三项核心属性」，属件结构不是数值）⇒ 不计入。
Outer Core (Courtesy backpack): empty bonus list; the text describes an extra core slot, which is item structure, not a value.

Only bonus armor during cover-to-cover is recorded. The defensive-core bonus after the distance is not added again.
只记装甲破坏后的生命值提升。持续时间和冷却不模拟。
Only the health increase after armor breaks is recorded. Duration and cooldown are not simulated.
只记摧毁敌方资产后的爆裂物伤害。持续时间不模拟。
Only explosive damage after destroying an enemy asset is recorded. Duration is not simulated.
只记随身武器击杀回复的装甲百分比。冷却不模拟。
Only the armor percent repaired by a sidearm kill is recorded. Cooldown is not simulated.
只记危害防护。它会进入各项异常抗性，不另加伤害。
Only hazard protection is recorded. It feeds status resistances and is not extra damage.
只记收起且处于致盲、出血或着火时的额外护甲。持续时间不模拟。
Only bonus armor while holstered and affected by blind, bleed, or burn is recorded. Duration is not simulated.
只记瞄准手雷时的额外护甲。手雷引爆时间不进这一项。
Only bonus armor while aiming a grenade is recorded. Grenade cook time is separate.
只记自己近距离的减伤。友军减伤和距离不进这一项。
Only your own close-range reduction is recorded. Ally reduction and distance are separate.
只记对精英的伤害加成，条件默认关闭。
Only damage against elites is recorded. The condition stays off by default.
只记收起时给其他武器的额外护甲百分比。
Only the bonus armor percent given to other weapons while holstered is recorded.
只记救起后的减伤。救援速度和持续时间不进这一项。
Only the damage reduction after a revive is recorded. Revive speed and duration are separate.
只记爆头击杀后的总武器伤害。普通爆头增伤不另加。
Only total weapon damage after a headshot kill is recorded. The normal headshot increase is not added again.
只在敌人距离内按额外护甲满层计入。距离和冷却不模拟。
Bonus armor is counted at full stacks only while an enemy is in range. Distance and cooldown are not simulated.
只记状态效果扩散范围。冷却不乘进去。
Only the status-effect spread range is recorded. Cooldown is not multiplied in.
完美死亡蔓延只记更大的扩散范围。冷却不乘进去。
Perfect Creeping Death records only the larger spread range. Cooldown is not multiplied in.
只计入射击后的技能伤害。持续时间不模拟，也不进枪械伤害。
Only the skill damage after shooting is counted. Duration is not simulated, and it is not firearm damage.
施加状态后，同一条官方数值同时计入技能伤害和技能修复。持续时间不模拟，不进枪械伤害。
After a status effect, the same official value counts as both skill damage and skill repair. Duration is not simulated, and it is not firearm damage.
只在施加控制后计入自身额外护甲。距离和持续时间不模拟。
Own bonus armor is counted after applying a control effect. Distance and duration are not simulated.
只计入护盾受损后给自己的额外护甲。给友军的部分不进自身面板。
Only the bonus armor granted to yourself after shield damage is counted. The ally portion is not on this panel.
只按击杀后的额外护甲满层计入。持续时间不模拟，不进枪械伤害。
Only bonus armor at full kill stacks is counted. Duration is not simulated and it is not firearm damage.
只对当前武器对应的距离档生效；需满足换枪、持续时间和距离条件。
Applies only to the current weapon class; enable after meeting swap, duration and distance requirements.
只记暴击回复失去装甲的官方百分比。击杀后的核心时长不在这里。
Only the official percent of missing armor repaired by a critical hit is recorded. The core-based kill duration is separate.
只记装甲包给的技能分阶。持续时间和冷却不乘进去。
Only the skill tier from an armor kit is recorded. Duration and cooldown are not multiplied in.
只计入部署技能范围内的装弹速度。每秒缩减冷却不模拟。
Only the reload speed inside a deployed skill is counted. Cooldown reduction per second is not simulated.
只计入掩体间移动给自己的额外护甲。近敌三倍和友军部分不默认相乘。
Only bonus armor granted to yourself by cover-to-cover is counted. The close-enemy multiplier and ally portion are not applied by default.
脉冲目标伤害修正是独立乘区，不并入总武器伤害或基础技能伤害。
The pulsed-target combat modifier is an independent multiplier, not total weapon damage or base skill damage.
源规则为逐实例独立乘区，仅额外护甲存在且目标在10米内生效；满层不是基础百分比乘层数。
Separate AddCombatModifier instances compound; requires bonus armor and target distance at most 10m.
上限进 HeadhunterCap，结转比例进 HeadhunterCarry。两档由档位层互斥选择，默认关闭。不进爆头伤，也不进独立增伤。
The cap uses HeadhunterCap and the carry ratio uses HeadhunterCarry. The tier layer picks one and stays off by default. Neither is headshot damage or amplify damage.
只记破甲后的装甲修复。冷却不乘进去。
Only armor repair after armor breaks is recorded. Cooldown is not multiplied in.
只计入部署护盾后给友军的额外护甲比例。无敌时间和冷却不模拟。
Only the ally bonus-armor portion after deploying a shield is counted. Invulnerability time and cooldown are not simulated.
左右技能各自独立叠层；总层数上限为官方单技能上限的两倍，技能伤害进入总技能伤害池。
Left and right skills stack independently. Combined cap is twice the official per-skill cap; damage uses the total-skill-damage pool.
同一数值同时加武器和技能伤害。等待时间不乘进去。
The same value adds both weapon and skill damage. The wait time is not multiplied in.
只记治疗友军后自己的武器伤害。友军增伤和技能分阶不乘进去。
Only your own weapon damage after healing an ally is recorded. Ally damage and skill tier are not multiplied in.
只计入自己装弹时的额外护甲。按防御核心分给友军的部分不在这里。
Only bonus armor while you reload is counted. The portion shared by defensive cores is separate.
只记专长装甲包效果的提高。不消耗的几率不模拟。
Only the increase to specialization armor-kit effects is recorded. The no-consume chance is not simulated.
只计入掩体内爆头回复的装甲比例。阈值和冷却不模拟，不进技能修复。
Only the armor portion repaired by a headshot in cover is counted. Threshold and cooldown are not simulated, and it is not skill repair.
只记瞄准手雷时的额外护甲。手雷范围没有对应字段。
Only bonus armor while aiming a grenade is recorded. Grenade radius has no matching field.
只记部署技能周围的电击范围。部署时间和冷却不乘进去。
Only the shock range around a deployed skill is recorded. Arm time and cooldown are not multiplied in.
只记技能分阶满时的爆炸伤害上限。低分阶不另加。
Only the explosion-damage cap at full skill tier is recorded. The lower tier is not added again.
只记击杀后获得的特殊弹药发数。冷却不乘进去。
Only the special ammo rounds gained after a kill are recorded. Cooldown is not multiplied in.
大张旗鼓（染血指节）：暴怒期间 武器伤害 +25% 进天赋武器伤池、近战伤害 +100% 进近战池；条件按理想状态（满层）计入。
Over the Top (Bloody Knuckles): Seeing Red grants +25% weapon damage (talent pool) and +100% melee damage (melee pool); conditions counted at ideal (full) state.
驱逐：官方参数名是 amplified_damage_dealt ⇒ 独立增伤（乘区）。自审脚本抓出来后改正。
Ostracize: official parameter is an amplified damage bonus (independent multiplier).
技能伤害只按满层上限记。武器伤害仍按技能分阶缩放，衰减不乘进去。
Skill damage uses the full stack cap. Weapon damage still scales by skill tier, and decay is not multiplied in.

counterLabel: 生效增益（1：技能命中；2：双增益）

note: 仅在开镜命中标记部位时启用。
Enable only when scoped hits land on the highlighted section.
制胜（Overdogs）：官方参数名就是 `amplified_damage_bonus` = 独立增伤 +30%（不是总武器伤）⇒ 进 `AmplifyDamage` 乘区。只对当前战斗中最低品阶的敌人生效。2026-10-16 用户指出后由 TotalWeaponDamage 改正。
Only against the lowest enemy rank in the current fight, and off by default.
头号威胁：官方参数名是 amplified_damage_bonus ⇒ 独立增伤（乘区），不是总武器伤。自审脚本抓出来后改正。
High-Priority Target: the official parameter is an amplified damage bonus, i.e. an independent multiplier.
1 是只有技能在范围内，2 是有队友在范围内。队友档正好是技能档的两倍，两组不会相加。
1 means a skill is in range. 2 means an ally is in range. The ally values are double the skill values, and the groups do not stack.
按这件面具已选的非核心属性颜色计入：攻击加暴击伤害，防御加装甲回复，效能加技能效率。核心属性和官方池里没有的属性不加。

Counted from this mask's selected non-core colors: offense adds critical hit damage, defense adds armor regeneration, utility adds skill efficiency. Core attributes and attributes outside the official pools are excluded.
连续射击的准确度按每发加到官方上限。坚持延迟的是受到的伤害，不计入武器伤害。
Accuracy from continuous fire stacks up to the official cap. Tenacity delays damage taken and is not weapon damage.
三个部位的增益可以同时存在，开启后一起计入。命中次数是各自的触发条件，不是层数乘数。
The three body-zone buffs can be active together and are all counted when enabled. Hit counts are triggers, not stack multipliers.
击杀层数只提高下一个弹匣的基础弹匣容量，不是每个弹匣常驻。
Kill stacks raise base magazine size for the next magazine, not every magazine.
护甲伤害只在强制瞄准生效时计入。层数是触发阈值，不是乘数；嘲讽不模拟。
Armor damage counts only while the forced-target effect is active. The stack count is the trigger threshold, not a multiplier; the taunt is not simulated.
只计入最终阈值的所有来源伤害。前面的状态效果不模拟，触发层数不是这份额外伤害的乘数。
Only the all-sources damage at the final threshold is counted. Earlier status effects are not simulated, and the trigger counts do not multiply this bonus.
层数是暴击伤害。装填时按层对自己造成的伤害是受到的伤害，不是护甲伤害加成。
Stacks are critical hit damage. Damage dealt to you per stack on reload is damage taken, not an armor-damage bonus.
只计入目标身上仍保留的每层增强伤害。爆头消耗层数会改用另一档每层增强伤害，摧毁弱点也是另一段增强伤害，这两段都不与持有层数相加。

Only amplified damage per stack still on the target is counted. A headshot consumes the stacks for a different per-stack amplify, and a destroyed weakpoint is a separate amplify; neither is added to the held stacks.
自己的标记给 20% 增强伤害。层数是其他特工的额外标记，最多 3 个，每个再加 5%。不是把 20% 按总标记连乘。
Your own mark grants 20% amplified damage. Stacks are other agents' extra marks, up to 3, at 5% each. The base is not multiplied by total marks.
只在两个技能都处于冷却时计入。不推断技能是否正在冷却。
Counted only while both skills are cooling down. Skill cooldown is not inferred.
每耗损官方规定的一档装甲，加一档武器伤害。档数由玩家填写，不读取当前装甲。
Each official missing-armor step adds one weapon-damage step. The player enters the step count; current armor is not read.
只在暴击率低于官方阈值时计入。不自动检查当前暴击率。
Counted only while critical hit chance is below the official threshold. Current chance is not checked automatically.
只计入收起时的爆头伤害。蓄力伤害不在这里。
Only the holstered headshot damage is counted. Charge damage is separate.
只计入穿甲后的武器伤害。持续时间不模拟。
Only the post-penetration weapon damage is counted. Duration is not simulated.
只计入换弹后的武器伤害。换弹比例不是这份额外伤害的乘数。
Only the post-reload weapon damage is counted. The reload portion does not multiply it.
只计入收起后的射速。持续时间不模拟。
Only the holstered rate of fire is counted. Duration is not simulated.
复调旋律（百夫长剑鞘）：官方是**两组轮流** —— ①+20% 射速 +20% 武器伤害 ②+50% 弹匣容量 +50% 换弹速度，切换武器才进入下一组、持续 12 秒（切枪本身要时间）。两组互斥、不能同时吃 ⇒ 只计第一组（伤害组），第二组（弹匣/换弹）不计；也不模拟切枪耗时。

Counter (Centurion's Scabbard): the official talent alternates between two groups on weapon swap (12s each); only one group is active at a time, and swapping costs time. Only group 1 (+20% RoF, +20% weapon damage) is counted.
只在腰射时计入稳定度。不判断当前是否瞄准。
Stability counts only while hip-firing. Current aim state is not checked.
装填速度在效果生效时计入。层数只乘武器伤害，不乘装填速度。
Reload speed counts while the effect is active. Stacks multiply weapon damage only, not reload speed.
只计入官方封顶的移动速度。翻越、静止和状态三段不重复相加。
Only the official movement-speed cap is counted. Vault, stationary and status portions are not added again.
只在范围内有敌人时计入伤害减免。距离不模拟。
Damage reduction is counted only while an enemy is in range. Distance is not simulated.
只按满层进攻增益计入武器伤害。防守减伤和转化后的另一段不在这里，两段不会同时满层。
Only weapon damage at full offensive stacks is counted. Defensive reduction and the converted phase are separate, and both phases are not full at once.
只计入近距这一档的暴击伤害。中距和远距是互斥的另一档，不与近距相加。
Only the close-range critical damage band is counted. Mid and far range are mutually exclusive bands and are not added.
只在耗损敌人护甲后的持续时间内计入。持续时间不模拟。
Counted only during the duration after breaking enemy armor. Duration is not simulated.
只计入击杀后的下一发爆头。不是持续爆头伤害。
Only the next headshot after a kill is counted. It is not sustained headshot damage.
层数是从背后射击的武器伤害。朝向不模拟。
Stacks are weapon damage while shooting a target from behind. Facing is not simulated.
只在击杀后换上手枪、并且仍使用那一匣时计入。换弹和时限不模拟。
Counted only for the sidearm magazine gained after a kill. The swap timer and refill are not simulated.
只计入范围内的危害防护。范围本身不模拟。
Only the hazard protection inside the radius is counted. The radius itself is not simulated.
只计入复活后队友受到的治疗。范围和持续时间不模拟。
Only incoming repairs after a revive are counted. Radius and duration are not simulated.
只在掩体停留达到官方秒数后，计入每秒护甲回复。等待时间不模拟。
Armor regeneration per second counts only after the official time in cover. The wait itself is not simulated.
只计入技能击杀后的技能伤害。持续时间和技能持续本身不模拟。
Only the skill damage after a skill kill is counted. Duration and skill uptime are not simulated.
只在耗损护甲后的持续时间内计入技能伤害。持续时间不模拟。
Skill damage counts only during the duration after breaking armor. Duration is not simulated.
只在掩体效果生效时计入技能伤害和修复。离开掩体与冷却不模拟。
Skill damage and repair count only while the cover effect is active. Leaving cover and the cooldown are not simulated.
蜂窝技能加速按当前技能阶数相乘。超载重置冷却不模拟。
Hive skill haste is multiplied by the current skill tier. Overcharge cooldown reset is not simulated.
只计入受灌注状态影响时的额外技能伤害。爆炸和范围不模拟。
Only the extra skill damage against infused enemies is counted. The explosion and radius are not simulated.
只在瞄准时计入稳定度。是否正在瞄准不自动判断。
Stability counts only while aiming. Current aim state is not checked automatically.
只在护甲全满时计入技能修复。当前护甲不自动判断。
Repair counts only at full armor. Current armor is not checked automatically.
只计入护甲全满时的技能修复。击杀后的另一段治疗提升不在这里相加。
Only the full-armor repair is counted. The separate healing increase after a kill is not added here.
只对没有瞄准你的敌人计入爆头和弱点增伤。瞄准镜信息和冷却重置不模拟。
Headshot and weak-point damage count only against enemies not targeting you. Scope information and cooldown reset are not simulated.
只按爆头满层计入。瞄准镜半自动和衰减不模拟。
Only headshot damage at full stacks is counted. Scoped semi-auto fire and stack decay are not simulated.
按状态效果叠满后计入武器伤害和状态效果。叠层速度、衰减和满层击杀奖励不模拟。
Weapon damage and status effects are counted at full stacks from status effects. Stack gain, decay and the full-stack kill bonus are not simulated.
按单个技能叠满后计入技能伤害。转移到另一个技能不模拟，不进枪械伤害。
Skill damage is counted at full stacks on one skill. Transfer to the other skill is not simulated, and it is not firearm damage.
每发消耗一层时的伤害是常数，不按层数相乘。移动速度不计入。
Damage while spending one stack per shot is a constant, not multiplied by stack count. Movement speed is not counted.
短增益按进攻核心的武器伤害计入。长增益按挂饰满层计入。两段不会同时成立，技能效率与加成护甲不在这里。
The short buff counts the offensive-core weapon damage. The long buff is counted at full trophy stacks. The two phases are not active together. Skill efficiency and bonus armor are separate.
只计入常开的手雷伤害。范围、携带量和每名敌人的额外伤害不在这里。
Only the always-on grenade damage is counted. Radius, capacity and extra damage per enemy are separate.
只计入爆头伤害。身躯减伤没有独立字段，结果里的身体命中不会下降。
Only headshot damage is counted. The body-shot penalty has no separate field, so body hits do not decrease.
